title: System One question proposal — wire schema
description: The decode contract for candidate declared questions proposed from policy text (S1-61 / CAP2-POLICY), per ADR 0046: the schema IS the contract, a schema-valid answer is a well-formed PROPOSAL never a true one, and an undecodable answer is a refusal with the raw output retained — never a best-effort parse.
$comment: Derivation: answer_type enum mirrors AshJudgments.Registry.Dsl's answer types (AshAi.Evaluate.Noul | Choice | Score; Evidence ships with UP-AI-EVIDENCE-TYPE and is deliberately refused until then). options carry the registry's rules: a Choice's options come from constraints (the abstain option is appended by the registry per law 7 and is NEVER model-provided, ADR 0046 point 5), a Score's levels, a Noul's [true, false] are derived — so Noul proposals must not carry options. name and family must be atom-safe: they become Spark identifiers and calibration family atoms. version is NOT model-provided: proposals are always proposed at version 1, and only a person changes a question after activation (ADR 0039 property 6). profile is NOT model-provided: the caller picks the in-zone instrument. There is no confidence field (ADR 0046 point 5). Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express (criteria keys equal the options; pii minimised requires a state shape) are enforced by the post-decode vocabulary pass — decode where the runtime can, validate always.

_comment.description: Documentation key (SPDX/REUSE annotations on fixtures and recordings). Ignored by decode.

clause_ref.description: The id of the source clause this proposal cites (lineage: clause to question).

name.description: The question's name — atom-safe; it becomes part of the structural question id.

answer_type.description: The registry's shipped answer types, lowercased. Anything else is refused, not coerced.

options.description: Choice options or Score levels, atom-safe, in declaration order (order is part of the question's identity). Absent for noul — its options are derived.

instructions.description: The question's wording, as the model proposes it. A person edits before confirmation; the confirmed wording is the declaration.

criteria.description: Per-option (or true/false) descriptions. If present, its keys must be exactly the options — checked in the vocabulary pass.

family.description: The calibration grouping, atom-safe (the registry's family is a DSL atom). Outside the question hash (RFC §3.2, Q3).

state_shape.description: The declared output shape of the state projection, if the question needs one; hashed into state_contract.

pii.description: minimised requires a state projection at declaration time (the registry's verifier enforces it); the vocabulary pass requires a state shape here.

then.$comment: A noul's options are derived [true, false]; a model that supplies them has misunderstood the contract.
